item.title: Mesh LLM: distributed AI computing on iroh
item.description:

item.title: A dock that wakes up reliably
item.description:
📝 Even the best Thunderbolt dock at the time, the CalDigit TS3, would occasionally fail to wake up the system. Intel's Thunderbolt 4 Announcement Press Deck specifically mentioned solving my very problem with a section stating Required PC wake from sleep when computer is connected to a Thunderbolt dock. Maybe it simply took too long to wake up.
🔗 Read more: https://fabiensanglard.net/tb4/index.html
